text_block_list.text: One night, as autumn deepened—

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Festival time, festival time! The 
Grand Shun Festival♪ Now then, what should 
I eat first?!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"Lapis. Today we're accompanying Waltz. 
Save playing around for later."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. A little won't hurt. There's 
still time before the Shinbaku begins, 
after all.

Today, along with Bubble Gum Fellow, I 
came to the Umamusume festival, the "Grand 
Equine Festival."

The 'Shundai Festival' is a major annual 
event held every autumn, where various 
festivities are held to pray for a 
brighter future for the Umamusume—

Our purpose was to participate in the 
'Shinmeke,' a sacred ritual held during 
this 'Shundai Festival.'

The "Shinmeiku" is an ancient and solemn 
ritual honoring and comforting the spirit 
of retired racehorses before the Three 
Goddesses――

Waltz of Shadow, who retired this year, 
decided to entrust all of her lifelong 
hopes and dreams to this Shinbaku.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—So this is the 'hoof plate' where you 
write down your feelings. The real thing's 
pretty big, huh.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
If anything, this seems too small to me. 
There are just so many things I want to 
write down and leave behind.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...I guess you have a point.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"……Once again, thank you for being by my 
side, even when you're so busy preparing 
for the Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you very much for coming 
despite your busy schedule.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's a huge milestone for my best friend. 
Doing this much is a given!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer?

—To me, all of the Heavenly Kings are 
figures of great gratitude who supported 
Bubble Gum Fellow.

And along the way, we've shared joys and 
sorrows— you are an irreplaceable partner 
to me.

"That was why I also felt the urge... to 
witness that turning point alongside 
Bubble Gum Fellow—"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
—I handed over the horseshoe plate. The 
ritual will begin shortly, so let's watch 
over it together.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~...! I'm starting to get nervous...! 
It's my first time seeing the Jinmeiku in 
person, after all...!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Same for me. Since it only happens once 
every few years, seeing it in person might 
actually be rarer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"To have everyone gather like this on such 
an occasion... I guess it must be really 
lucky, huh."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, truly.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: —Tonight, I want everyone to witness this.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
The moment my feelings become an undying 
flame... and turn into a light passed on 
to the "next"—
...And at last, the Shinbaku began—

The horseshoe plate inscribed with Waltz 
of Shadow's feelings was offered to the 
sacred flames by the chosen divine horse—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"So much has happened... leading up to 
today, hasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. A lot of things happened.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
—You know... I can remember the day you 
first came to the club just like it was 
yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
When Father brought you to us, you greeted 
us with a bright smile—

text_block_list.name: Young Bubble
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be in your care starting today! I'm 
Bubble Gum Fellow!"

text_block_list.name: Young Bubble
text_block_list.text:
"I aim to become an incredibly strong 
Umamusume! I look forward to working with 
you!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, I remember! Right after that, Waltz 
came up and asked, "Let's run together!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"That really made me happy~ It felt like I 
was being welcomed in."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"Pfft... Fufu— I knew you were thinking 
that."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Quite the opposite, Bubble. Back then, I 
just wanted to show off my skills and 
tease you a little.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Was that really it...?

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"Club representative's daughter or not, 
we're not letting her act all high and 
mighty the moment she arrives," they said.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...I was just a child.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
In the end, though, you showed me yours 
instead. That splendid potential of 
yours...

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: And... my heart was pounding so fast.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
To think that from now on, I get to 
compete in the club alongside such an 
amazing girl—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu... Ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...Bubble?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Sorry. I'm just a little happy.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...You know, I felt the same way on that 
day.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Running with Waltz was so fierce... My 
heart was pounding so hard.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...I promise.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I will inherit Waltz's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...The reason I can run like this today 
is thanks to Waltz and the others."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, as long as I run, the "Four 
Heavenly Kings" will continue to exist on 
the turf.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I won't let anyone forget...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—In the upcoming "Japan Cup," I'll prove 
it once again.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
The strongest of the era is one of the 
"Four Heavenly Kings." They say it's the 
vanguard, Bubble Gum Fellow.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
—Then I will pass down the hoofprints of 
the 'Four Heavenly Kings' as techniques to 
the next generation.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
And in turn, I too will leave behind proof 
of the path we ran for the future.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
...Make sure not to leave everything to 
our "point woman."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Haha—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...That's really reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Someday, let us all bear witness to it 
together as the Heavenly Kings.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
The moment the whirlwind we created, over 
time... stirs up an even greater 
whirlwind.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ......Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to that day—

And on the way back from watching the 
Sacred Horse Run—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—The Shinba Kakeru was incredible, wasn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
......If the day ever comes when I write 
on the "Hoofboard"—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, I want to proudly 
write that I became a powerful Umamusume 
who turned the racing world upside down.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And then, you know... The moment those 
feelings turn into flames—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“—Just like today, I want to watch over it 
all together with you, Trainer.”

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Bubble-chan! Trainer-san! The bus is about 
to leave~!? We're gonna leave you 
behind~?!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! Coming right now!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, shall we head back?
......That day, which will surely come.

So that Bubble Gum Fellow and I can take 
pride in our journey thus far.

"From here on out, I will forge a future 
together with her. ...That was the vow I 
made in my heart."
